supporting_observations.claim: WS-RDIAZ-01 made repeated TCP connections to the internal proxy at 10.56.20.30:8080 during the alerted period; the provided records include sessions at 13:31, 13:40, 13:46, 13:55, 14:01, 14:05, and 14:10 UTC.

The later sessions are roughly five minutes apart: 14:01:05, 14:05:55, and 14:10:54 UTC. The records show proxy-bound HTTP connections, but do not identify the external HTTPS destination or originating process for these sessions.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records for the alerted sessions show connections to the explicit proxy, not the ultimate HTTPS destination.
The listed Zeek connection records do not provide process attribution, and the provided proxy records do not identify a corresponding destination for these particular sessions.
The available records are a subset of activity in the review window, so they do not establish the complete connection cadence or explain every session.
claims_not_established: Whether the alerted sessions were generated by the approved GradeBook Pro updater or by another process.
Whether the sessions reached an approved service, an unapproved destination, or a malicious endpoint.
Whether data exchanged in the sessions was benign application traffic or malicious command-and-control or transfer activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy request and CONNECT logs for the alerted timestamps, including destination hostnames, tunnel IDs, and byte counts, correlated with the listed Zeek connections.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-RDIAZ-01 at the alerted timestamps, including process path, command line, parent process, and executable signature or hash.
GradeBook Pro updater execution and update logs for the same period, to determine whether it generated the connections.
unrelated_findings: Separate investigation: DC-ORC-01 recorded NTLM validation for amy.cole from WS-RDIAZ-01, followed by a network logon for amy.cole to WS-ACOLE-01 from that workstation; this is not tied to the alerted proxy sessions (T265-00093, T265-00094).

Separate investigation: at 14:17 UTC, taskhostw.exe on WS-RDIAZ-01 used explicit credentials for svc-grades with PROXY-ORC-01 as the target (T265-00336). This occurs outside the alerted connection interval.

Separate investigation: WS-RDIAZ-01 accessed Google Drive through the proxy at 14:17–14:18 UTC, a service not listed among the approved services (T265-00342, T265-00343, T265-00344, T265-00352, T265-00354).
